screenLevelIssues.explanation: The header implementation does not match the design. The code renders a navigation header with a back button, while the design shows a dashboard-style header with a greeting and user avatar.

The design includes a segmented control/tab switcher ('Recent Payments' | 'Cashbacks') between the carousel indicators and the cashback section. This component is entirely missing from the implementation.
The code implements an 'Apply Cashback' toggle which is not present in the design. The design instead shows a 'CASHBACK ACCRUED' label followed by a large amount display (₹ 325.00).
screenLevelIssues.currentCode:
<View style={styles.cashbackToggleRow}>
  <View style={styles.cashbackLabelContainer}>
    <Text style={styles.cashbackLabelText}>Apply Cashback</Text>
  </View>
  <CashbackToggle enabled={useCashback} onToggle={setUseCashback} />
</View>

screenLevelIssues.explanation: The 'Complete setup' section is implemented as a simple text block. The design requires a styled card containing a countdown timer and a 3-step vertical stepper list (Bank details, Address proof, Invite landlord).

The footer button and the amount text container should share the footer width equally (approx 164px each based on Figma data). The current implementation relies on default sizing which may not match the 50/50 distribution.
